segments.mn78:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn78:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto [samaṇamaṇḍikāputto (sī. pī.)] samayappavādake tindukācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
segments.mn78:2.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati sāvatthiyā nikkhami divā divassa bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
segments.mn78:2.7: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkameyyan”ti.
segments.mn78:2.8: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkami.
segments.mn78:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā, seyyathidaṃ – rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
segments.mn78:3.3: Addasā kho uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.mn78:3.6: ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati pañcakaṅgo thapati.
segments.mn78:3.7: Yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro pañcakaṅgo thapati.
segments.mn78:3.8: Appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino;
segments.mn78:3.9: appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
segments.mn78:3.10: Atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.mn78:4.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamuṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn78:4.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto etadavoca –
segments.mn78:5.1: “catūhi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
segments.mn78:5.3: Idha, gahapati, na kāyena pāpakammaṃ karoti, na pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati – imehi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhan”ti.
segments.mn78:6.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi.
segments.mn78:7.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn78:7.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yāvatako ahosi uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamuṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
segments.mn78:8.1: Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn78:8.2: “evaṃ sante kho, thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
segments.mn78:8.3: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyotipi na hoti, kuto pana kāyena pāpakammaṃ karissati, aññatra phanditamattā!
segments.mn78:8.4: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācātipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati, aññatra roditamattā!
segments.mn78:8.5: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa saṅkappotipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappissati, aññatra vikūjitamattā [vikujjitamattā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)]!
segments.mn78:8.6: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvotipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati, aññatra mātuthaññā!
segments.mn78:8.7: Evaṃ sante kho, thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
segments.mn78:8.8: “Catūhi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ, api cimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn78:8.10: Idha, thapati, na kāyena pāpakammaṃ karoti, na pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati – imehi kho ahaṃ, thapati, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ, api cimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn78:9.1: “Dasahi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
segments.mn78:9.8: Evaṃ paṭipanno akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti;
segments.mn78:9.16: Evaṃ paṭipanno kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti;
segments.mn78:9.24: Evaṃ paṭipanno akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti;
segments.mn78:9.32: Evaṃ paṭipanno kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti;
segments.mn78:10.2: Akusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, akusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ, pāpako ājīvo – ime vuccanti, thapati, akusalā sīlā.
segments.mn78:10.9: Yaṃ cittaṃ sarāgaṃ sadosaṃ samohaṃ, itosamuṭṭhānā akusalā sīlā.
segments.mn78:10.10: “Ime ca, thapati, akusalā sīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
segments.mn78:10.12: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti – etthete akusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
segments.mn78:10.14: “Kathaṃ paṭipanno, thapati, akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
segments.mn78:10.15: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:10.16: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:10.17: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:10.18: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.mn78:10.19: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.mn78:11.2: Kusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, kusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ, ājīvaparisuddhampi kho ahaṃ, thapati, sīlasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn78:11.9: Yaṃ cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ, itosamuṭṭhānā kusalā sīlā.
segments.mn78:11.10: “Ime ca, thapati, kusalā sīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
segments.mn78:11.12: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti no ca sīlamayo, tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
segments.mn78:11.13: yatthassa te kusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
segments.mn78:11.14: “Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
segments.mn78:11.15: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:11.16: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya … pe … anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya … pe … uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.mn78:11.19: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.mn78:12.2: Kāmasaṅkappo, byāpādasaṅkappo, vihiṃsāsaṅkappo – ime vuccanti, thapati, akusalā saṅkappā.
segments.mn78:12.9: Kāmasaññā, byāpādasaññā, vihiṃsāsaññā – itosamuṭṭhānā akusalā saṅkappā.
segments.mn78:12.11: “Ime ca, thapati, akusalā saṅkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
segments.mn78:12.13: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn78:12.15: “Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
segments.mn78:12.16: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:12.17: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya … pe … anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya … pe … uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.mn78:12.20: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, akusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.mn78:13.2: Nekkhammasaṅkappo, abyāpādasaṅkappo, avihiṃsāsaṅkappo – ime vuccanti, thapati, kusalā saṅkappā.
segments.mn78:13.9: Nekkhammasaññā, abyāpādasaññā, avihiṃsāsaññā – itosamuṭṭhānā kusalā saṅkappā.
segments.mn78:13.11: “Ime ca, thapati, kusalā saṅkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
segments.mn78:13.13: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn78:13.15: “Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
segments.mn78:13.16: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
segments.mn78:13.17: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya … pe … anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya … pe … uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.mn78:13.20: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, kusalānaṃ saṅkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.mn78:14.1: “Katamehi cāhaṃ, thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ?
segments.mn78:14.2: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu asekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsaṅkappena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvācāya samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammākammantena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāājīvena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāvāyāmena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāsatiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāñāṇena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvimuttiyā samannāgato hoti – imehi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhan”ti.
segments.mn78:14.5: Attamano pañcakaṅgo thapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Kiñci kiñci pana uggahituṃ uggāhetuṃ samatthatāya uggāhamānoti naṃ sañjānanti.

Tasmiṃ kira ṭhāne caṅkītārukkhapokkharasātippabhutayo brāhmaṇā nigaṇṭhācelakaparibbājakādayo ca pabbajitā sannipatitvā attano attano samayaṃ pavadanti kathenti dīpenti, tasmā so ārāmo samayappavādakoti vuccati.
Yasmā panettha paṭhamaṃ ekā sālā ahosi, pacchā mahāpuññaṃ poṭṭhapādaparibbājakaṃ nissāya bahū sālā katā, tasmā tameva ekaṃ sālaṃ upādāya laddhanāmavasena ekasālakoti vuccati.
Mallikāya pana pasenadirañño deviyā uyyānabhūto so pupphaphalasañchanno ārāmoti katvā mallikāya ārāmoti saṅkhaṃ gato.
Tasmiṃ samayappavādake tindukācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme.
Divā divassāti divasassa divā nāma majjhanhātikkamo, tasmiṃ divasassapi divābhūte atikkantamatte majjhanhike nikkhamīti attho.
Paṭisallīnoti tato tato rūpādigocarato cittaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā līno, jhānaratisevanavasena ekībhāvaṃ gato.
Manobhāvanīyānanti manavaḍḍhanakānaṃ, ye āvajjato manasikaroto cittaṃ vinīvaraṇaṃ hoti unnamati vaḍḍhati.
Ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataroti ayaṃ tesaṃ abbhantaro eko sāvako.
Etadavocāti dandapañño ayaṃ gahapati, dhammakathāya naṃ saṅgaṇhitvā attano sāvakaṃ karissāmīti maññamāno etaṃ “catūhi kho”tiādivacanaṃ avoca.
Ayojjhanti vādayuddhena yujjhitvā cāletuṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ acalaṃ nikkampaṃ thiraṃ.
Na karotīti akaraṇamattameva vadati, ettha pana saṃvarappahānaṃ vā paṭisevanappahānaṃ vā na vadati.
Neva abhinandīti titthiyā nāma jānitvāpi ajānitvāpi yaṃ vā taṃ vā vadantīti maññamāno nābhinandi.
Na paṭikkosīti sāsanassa anulomaṃ viya pasannākāraṃ viya vadatīti maññamāno na paṭisedheti.
Yathā uggāhamānassāti yathā tassa vacanaṃ, evaṃ sante uttānaseyyako kumāro ayojjhasamaṇo thirasamaṇo bhavissati, mayaṃ pana evaṃ na vadāmāti dīpeti.
Kāyotipi na hotīti sakakāyo parakāyotipi visesañāṇaṃ na hoti.
Aññatra phanditamattāti paccattharaṇe valisamphassena vā maṅguladaṭṭhena vā kāyaphandanamattaṃ nāma hoti.
Taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ kāyena karaṇakammaṃ nāma natthi.
Vācātipi na hotīti micchāvācā sammāvācātipi nānattaṃ na hoti.
Daharakumārakānañhi cittaṃ atītārammaṇaṃ pavattati, nirayato āgatā nirayadukkhaṃ saritvā rodanti, devalokato āgatā hasanti, tampi kilesasahagatacitteneva hoti.
Aññatra mātuthaññāti thaññacoradārakā nāma honti, mātari khīraṃ pāyantiyā apivitvā aññavihitakāle piṭṭhipassena āgantvā thaññaṃ pivanti.
Evaṃ paribbājakavādaṃ paṭikkhipitvā idāni sayaṃ sekkhabhūmiyaṃ mātikaṃ ṭhapento catūhi kho ahantiādimāha.
Na kāyena pāpa kammantiādīsu na kevalaṃ akaraṇamattameva, bhagavā pana ettha saṃvarappahānapaṭisaṅkhā paññapeti.
Na ceva sampannakusalantiādi pana khīṇāsavaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Idāni asekkhabhūmiyaṃ mātikaṃ ṭhapento dasahi kho ahantiādimāha.
Tattha tīṇi padāni nissāya dve paṭhamacatukkā ṭhapitā, ekaṃ padaṃ nissāya dve pacchimacatukkā.
Idāni taṃ vibhajanto katame ca thapati akusalasīlātiādimāha.
Itosamuṭṭhānāti ito sarāgādicittato samuṭṭhānaṃ uppatti etesanti itosamuṭṭhānā.
Pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlañhi sotāpattiphale paripuṇṇaṃ hoti, taṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā akusalasīlaṃ asesaṃ nirujjhati.
Akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipannoti ettha yāva sotāpattimaggā nirodhāya paṭipanno nāma hoti, phalapatte pana te nirodhitā nāma honti.
No ca sīlamayoti alamettāvatā, natthi ito kiñci uttari karaṇīyanti evaṃ sīlamayo na hoti.
Nirodhāya paṭipannoti ettha yāva arahattamaggā nirodhāya paṭipanno nāma hoti, phalapatte pana te nirodhitā nāma honti.
Kāmasaññā dīsu kāmasaññā aṭṭhalobhasahagatacittasahajātā, itarā dve domanassasahagatacittadvayena sahajātā.
Nirodhāya paṭipannoti ettha yāva anāgāmimaggā nirodhāya paṭipanno nāma hoti, phalapatte pana te nirodhitā nāma honti.
Dutiyajjhānikaṃ arahattaphalañhi pāpuṇitvā kusalasaṅkappā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
Nirodhāya paṭipannoti ettha yāva arahattamaggā nirodhāya paṭipanno nāma hoti, phalapatte pana te nirodhitā nāma honti.
Uggāhetunti sikkhāpetuṃ, pāṭhato attanā yathāuggahitamatthaṃ tabbibhāvanatthāya uccāraṇavasena paresaṃ gāhetunti attho.
Sā hi saṃyojanabhāvato sameti sambandhā eti pavattati, daḷhaggahaṇabhāvato vā saṃyuttā ayanti pavattanti sattā yathābhinivesaṃ etenāti samayoti vuccati.
Sūriyassa uggamanato atthaṅgamā ayaṃ ettako kālo rattandhakāravidhamanato divā nāma, tassa pana majjhimapahārasaññito kālo samujjalitapabhātejadahanabhāvena divā nāma.
Evaṃ cittassa paṭisaṃharaṇaṃ nāma gocarakkhette ṭhapananti āha “jhānaratisevanavasena ekībhāvaṃ gato”ti.
Sīlādiguṇavisesayogato manasā sambhāvanīyā, te pana yasmā attano sīlādiguṇehi viññūnaṃ manāpā honti (kilesaaniggahassa pañcapasādāyattattā,) tasmā āha “manavaḍḍhanakānan”tiādi.
“anussaraṇampahaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahūpakāraṃ vadāmī”ti (itivu.104; saṃ. ni.5.184).
Ayojjhanti vādayuddhena ayodhanīyaṃ, vādayuddhaṃ hotu, tena parājayo na hotīti dasseti, tenāha “vādayuddhenā”tiādi.
Saṃvarappahānanti pañcasu saṃvaresu yena kenaci saṃvarena saṃvaralakkhaṇaṃ pahānaṃ.

Sāsane tiṇṇaṃ duccaritānaṃ micchājīvassa vivajjanaṃ vaṇṇīyati, ayañca evaṃ katheti, tasmā sāsanassa anulomaṃ viya vadati, vadanto ca sammāsambuddhe dhamme cassa appasādaṃ na dasseti, tasmā pasannakārampi vadatīti maññamāno tassa vādaṃ na paṭisedheti.
Yathā tassa vacanaṃ, evaṃ santeti yathā tassa paribbājakassa vacanaṃ, evaṃ samaṇabhāve sante labbhamāne.
Mayaṃ pana evaṃ na vadāmāti etena samaṇabhāvo nāma evaṃ na hotīti dasseti.
Yo hi dhammo yādiso, tatheva taṃ buddhā dīpenti.
Visesañāṇaṃ na hotīti kāyavisesavisayañāṇaṃ tassa tadā natthi, yato parakāye upakkamaṃ kareyyāti dasseti, tassa pana tattha visesañāṇampi natthevāti.
Yasmā kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ kāyakammaṃ, tasmā taṃ nivattento āha “aññatra phanditamattā”ti.
Vikūjitamattāti ettha virūpaṃ kūjitaṃ vikūjitaṃ pubbenivāsasannissayaṃ upayaṃ, taṃ panettha rodanahasanasamuṭṭhāpakacittasahagatanti dosasahagataṃ lobhasahagatañcāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Akusalacittaṃ pana atītārammaṇaṃ pavattatīti vattabbameva natthi.
Saritvāti yāva na satisaṇṭhāpanā dhammā uppajjanti, tāva supinante anubhūtaṃ viya dukkhaṃ saritvā rodanti.
Ayañca nayo ye laddhasukhārammaṇā hutvā gahitapaṭisandhikā mātukucchitopi sukheneva nikkhamanti, tesaṃ vasena vuttoti daṭṭhabbo.
Ayampīti ājīvopi mātu aññavihitakāle ca lokassādavasena kilesasahagatacitteneva hoti.
Samadhigayhāti sammā adhigatabhāvena gahetvā abhibhavitvā visesetvā visiṭṭho hutvā.
Ayañhettha attho – khīṇāsavampi sotāpannakusalaṃ paññapeti sekkhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhitattā.

Tīṇi padāni nissāyāti na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti, na pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvatīti imāni tīṇi padāni nissāya kusalasīlamūlakā ca akusalasīlamūlakā cāti dve paṭhamacatukkā ṭhapitā.
Ekaṃ padaṃ nissāyāti na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappetīti imaṃ ekapadaṃ nissāya kusalasaṅkappamūlakā akusalasaṅkappamūlakā cāti ime dve pacchimacatukkā ṭhapitā.
Sā pana heṭṭhimakoṭiyā sotāpattiphalena dīpetabbāti āha “sotāpattiphale bhumman”ti.
Yasmā ājīvaṭṭhamakaṃ avasiṭṭhañca sīlaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlassa ca pārisuddhipātimokkhādhigamena sotāpattiphalappattiyā siddho hotīti āha –
Yo sīlamatte patiṭṭhito, na samādhipaññāsu, so sīlamayadhammapūritatāya sīlamayo.
Tadubhayañca yasmā arahattaphale saṅgahitaṃ, tasmā vuttaṃ “arahattaphale bhumman”ti.
Ettha ca ujuvipaccanīkena paṭipakkhappahānaṃ sātisayanti paṭhamajjhānaggahaṇaṃ.
Nekkhammasaññānaṃ kāmāvacaracittasahagatatā tassa sīlassa samuṭṭhānatā ca sampayuttanayena veditabbā.
